title: MOTION (PRICE - HUTT) relative to funding for the Council District 9 (CD 9) Community Grants Program.
text:
[Council File 26-1601]
[Items for which Public Hearings Have Not Been Held - (10 Votes Required for Consideration)]
MOTION (PRICE - HUTT) relative to funding for the Council District 9 (CD 9) Community Grants Program.
Recommendation(s) for Council action, SUBJECT TO THE APPROVAL OF THE MAYOR:
1. INSTRUCT the City Clerk to transfer $613,085.10 from the CD 9 Public Benefits Trust, Fund No. 48X/14, Appr. No. 140001, to the CD 9 Community Grants Program, Fund No. 48X/14, Appr. No. 14C090.
2. AUTHORIZE the City Clerk to make any corrections, clarifications or revisions to the above fund transfer instructions, including any new instructions, in order to effectuate the intent of this Motion, and including any corrections and changes to fund or account numbers; said corrections / clarifications / changes may be made orally, electronically or by any other means.
